dedupe_keys.name: polnilnice za e vozila na obmocju mestne obcine maribor

description: Polnilnice za e-vozila na območju Mestne občine Maribor is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA MARIBOR. E-vehicle charging station set up on publicly accessible areas where electric vehicles can be charged by all e-vehicle users. Charging stations for e-vehicles contain information on the locations of charging stations owned by different stakeholders: The municipalities of Maribor, Elektro Maribor, Dravske Elektrarne, Elektro Maribor Energija Plus and Petrol. Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA MARIBOR. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for e-vehicles in the area of the Municipality of Maribor" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA MARIBOR. Its keywords include Promet, Komunalne in javne storitve, Mobilnost, Polnilne postaje. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
